description.content:
This controller is responsible for searching data objects.
    There are available endpoints for:
    * simple global searches - return only basic information about data objects
    * searching on lists - return more information about data objects

    Sorting (ascending by default, use `-` prefix to sort descending):
    * updatedat
    * value
    * visitscount
    * lastvisitdate
    * distance
    * nextactivitytime
    * lastvisitresult
Global search for objects, search should use address or other characteristic fields
